rawContent: Watching the "police" grab & yank this baby around is so disgusting. These people place no value on the lives of black people even in infancy. #BlackLivesMatter I hope Jasmine Headley and her child receive justice.
Walks in police station uninjured, a few hours he is beaten to death... My soul is tired of seeing my people murdered #Justiceformeek  #BlackLivesMatter

There are those who are asking the devotees of civil rights, “When will you be satisfied?” We can never be satisfied as long as the Negro is the victim of the unspeakable horrors of police brutality #MLKday #BlackLivesMatter
